exposure: Labour induction with a single dose of misoprostol
Labour induction with multiple doses of misoprostol
outcome: Duration of the second stage of labor
Cesarean section ratio due to fetal distress
Time from the last dose to delivery
cohort: 213 pregnant women who gave birth vaginally
finding: Intravaginal misoprostol seems to be a promising medical agent for labor induction due to its high delivery rates within 12 hours and the absence of negative fetal outcomes.
